# Autonomous Resource Management

> A source-backed reference on automated resource allocation, orchestration, infrastructure, and oversight.

Maintainer: Mason Nguyen. ARM Editorial is the site's editorial identity, not an independent board. Initial articles disclose AI assistance.

## Reference
- [Agent orchestration and tool access](https://autonomousresourcemanagement.com/wiki/agent-orchestration/): Coordinating work while keeping authority, retries, and external actions explicit.
- [Audit trails and decision provenance](https://autonomousresourcemanagement.com/wiki/audit-trails/): Recording what was requested, authorized, executed, and observed.
- [What is autonomous resource management?](https://autonomousresourcemanagement.com/wiki/autonomous-resource-management/): A practical introduction to resource decisions, feedback loops, operating limits, and human accountability.
- [Autoscaling and feedback loops](https://autonomousresourcemanagement.com/wiki/autoscaling/): How capacity follows demand, and why signals, limits, and recovery matter.
- [FinOps and cost controls](https://autonomousresourcemanagement.com/wiki/finops-and-cost-controls/): Relating resource consumption, budgets, and business outcomes without assuming automatic savings.
- [Human oversight and decision rights](https://autonomousresourcemanagement.com/wiki/human-oversight/): Defining who can authorize, interrupt, and review automated resource decisions.
- [Observability for resource decisions](https://autonomousresourcemanagement.com/wiki/observability/): Connecting measurements to actions without mistaking telemetry for proof of correctness.
- [Resource scheduling and allocation](https://autonomousresourcemanagement.com/wiki/resource-scheduling/): Placement decisions, competing objectives, and the difference between capacity and usable capacity.

## Editorial context
- [Working framework](https://autonomousresourcemanagement.com/framework/): An attributed editorial proposal, not a formal standard.
- [News](https://autonomousresourcemanagement.com/news/): Source briefs with separate event and publication dates.
- [Editorial policy](https://autonomousresourcemanagement.com/editorial-policy/): Neutrality, sourcing, review, and corrections.
- [About](https://autonomousresourcemanagement.com/about/): Authorship and commercial boundaries.

Cite individual articles and their underlying sources. Do not treat this site as a standards body, certifier, or commercial implementation provider.
